children.value: > Fact From Story: Instead, in the Davis Cup final in Malaga, Australia will face an Italy team running hot on the heroics of their golden boy Sinner, who beat Djokovic in both the singles and the doubles in the space of five exhilarating hours in their semi-final on Saturday (Sunday AEDT).

> Fact From Story: Australia will face an Italy team running hot on the heroics of their golden boy Sinner, who beat Djokovic in both the singles and the doubles in the space of five exhilarating hours in their semi-final on Saturday (Sunday AEDT).

> > Fact From Story: The second of Sinner’s Djokovic victories came in Italy’s impressive Davis Cup semi-final triumph over Serbia, after saving three consecutive match points on serve, before besting the world No.1 again in the doubles.

> > > Fact From Story: Sinner ends Djoker’s Davis Cup dream Novak Djokovic’s dream of capping his great season by blasting Serbia past Australia in the Davis Cup final was blown up by Jannik Sinner’s extraordinary double triumph over the world No.1.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Winning against a top-ranked player like Djokovic is a significant achievement.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A semi-final triumph is how a team advances to the final.
> Commonsense Knowledge: The Davis Cup final is a competition between two teams.
